saw_lines: Creators buy a drone or action camera once, then return for the accessory, battery or gimbal that goes with it.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, where a creator decides whether to click.
Your site shows 3457 reviews, yet 0 of 28 live ads carry a proof number, so put the review count on every new creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 3457 reviews, yet 0 of 28 live ads carry a proof number, so cold buyers have no reason to trust the drone. Put the review count on every new creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 26 ads mention it, so a first-time buyer has no price reason to act. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
Your site runs subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads name a subscription, so repeat buyers never hear about it. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at past buyers.
The offer appears after 77% of the copy on a median ad of 72 words, so buyers read most of the copy before they see it. Move the offer into the first two lines of every ad.
